title: Visa Policy
summary: Visa guidance and support letter information for IEEE SSCI 2027 participants.

sections.heading: Visa Support
paragraphs: Australia offers a structured and accessible visa system for academic conference attendees from around the world. IEEE SSCI 2027 will provide visa guidance, official documentation, and personalized assistance to support a smooth entry process.
A full list of visa options by nationality is available from the Australian Government visa finder: https://immi.homeaffairs.gov.au/visas/getting-a-visa/visa-finder/visit

rows: Citizens of the EU, UK, and several other European countries
Passport holders from the USA, Canada, Japan, South Korea, Singapore, and others
Apply via the Australian ETA app or authorized agents
All other countries, including India, China, Bangladesh, Pakistan, Nigeria, and others
2-4 weeks, longer for high-risk regions; apply at least 6-8 weeks in advance

sections.heading: Visa Support Letter
paragraphs: IEEE SSCI 2027 will provide personalized visa support letters upon request for registered authors, presenters, and attendees. A sample visa support letter will be made available for download and customization through the conference website.
bullets: Full conference details, including title, location, and dates
Confirmation of registration or accepted paper
Contact details of the organizing committee
